description.describe_ch: 過去以往重視產品的管理，但近年來產品設計與品牌有較高關聯也愈受重視。從產品相關的管理、開發、設計至商品化，根據產品目標特性設定不同價格策略，方能將產品成功的商品化甚至到品牌化。除此之外，外部經濟產業環境動態與消費者行為分析皆須考量，方能確實的開發設計一個成功的商品。最後以實務演練操作來提升學習成效。
description.describe_eh: Product management no longer fits current business needs. These few years' product design has been emphasized and highly related to branding in the practice. This course introduces not only from product management, development, and design to commercialize the end product but also how product features and target market related to pricing strategies accordingly in order to market a product successfully and eventually build up brand recognition. Additionally, analysis and understanding of dynamic external economy and industry changes must be considered to ensure developing and designing a winning product. Hopefully, management and design of products and pricing strategies in simulated practical operational settings can facilitate learning the subject.

targets.describe_ch: 了解全球市場導向於新產品開發
targets.describe_en: Conprehend global market trend in developing new product.

targets.describe_ch: 應用系統化設計流程於商品創新能力
targets.describe_en: Apply product design processes systematically to create a new product.

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: It's learnig-by-doing class, participation is important.
The class practice will become the assignment, keep recording the product design process is critical.

These will include a team-beased designer (10%), mid-term, and final presentation (each 15%). 
Designer presentations are to share well-known designer'concepts and product appreciation. This will enhance students' global view of concurrent product design.
The mid-term exam is a checking point for understanding student's learning and accordingly to make teaching adjustments.
This will be within team evaluation to prevent "free-rider" in a team.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be achieved by maintaining mutual dignity and mutual respect among classmates and teachers. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by each other's classroom behavior rules, and get used to a culture of politeness.
1.	Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
2.	All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
3.	Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. 
4.	You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
5.	Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
6.	Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent.
7.	Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class. 
Thank you for your cooperation!
